The '''''Neutralizer''-class bomber''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] developed by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Sith–Imperial War]] using the designs of the [[Predator-class fighter|''Predator''-class fighter]]. The [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] were used by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-backed [[Fel Empire]] in its battles against the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]; however, they saw limited use following the end of the conflict. When forces loyal to [[Attack on Emperor Fel|deposed]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] began to rebel against [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|regime]], the Sith-led Empire began sending ''Neutralizer''-class bombers to perform air strikes against locations believed to be hiding those sympathetic to the [[Empire-in-exile|Emperor-in-exile]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Neutralizer''-class [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] was a multi-purpose [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]], in use by [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]]. Developed by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]]' [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] by adapting the designs of their [[Predator-class fighter|''Predator''-class TIE fighter]], the Neutralizer was larger, bulkier, and less agile than the Predator. Featuring impressive [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] for a fighter of its size, the ship was also nimble for a bomber and was capable of reaching speeds of 1,500 kilometers per hour in atmosphere. The bomber was also equipped with a Class 1.0 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], and a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]] for interstellar travel.<ref name="LECG" />

The Neutralizer had space for one [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], and it was outfitted with two medium [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launcher that could fire its complement of 10 proton torpedoes. The bomber was also able to hold a [[Standard week/Legends|week's]] worth of consumables and supported up to 110 kilograms of cargo.<ref name="LECG" />

==Role==
A multi-purpose bomber, the Neutralizer filled a diverse range of roles. Its primary purpose was strafing enemy ground emplacements and breaking open defensible positions. The ''Neutralizer''-class bomber was also used to perform air strikes against positions suspected of hosting enemy sympathizers.<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
During the conflict between the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-backed [[Fel Empire]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] beginning in [[127 ABY]]&mdash;known as the [[Sith–Imperial War]]&mdash;the ''Neutralizer''-class bomber was developed by Sienar Fleet Systems' engineers by modifying the ''Predator''-class starfighter. Compared to the Predator fighter, few Neutralizers were assembled, although the bomber saw use in the [[Massacre at Ossus|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] at the end of the war.<ref name="LECG" />

As its main purpose was assaulting defensible positions and strafing ground emplacements, the Neutralizer saw limited use after the Sith–Imperial War. However, when the forces loyal to [[Empire-in-exile|Emperor-in-exile]] [[Roan Fel]], who had been [[Attack on Emperor Fel|overthrown]] by Darth Krayt, began to rise up against the Sith regime, Krayt's Empire started sending ''Neutralizer''-class bombers to perform air strikes against positions suspected of harboring sympathizers to the deposed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Fel.<ref name="LECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Neutralizer''-class bomber was first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] sourcebook the ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''.<ref name="LECG" />
